title: Tungaloy SH7025 grade-level cutting baselines
purpose: Publish Tungaloy's SH7025 grade-level recommended cutting conditions (cutting speed by ISO material, depth of cut by chipbreaker, feed by corner radius) on every exact insert carrying grade SH7025, as adjustable baseline starting values.
